Name: Kingdom Hearts Shirts
Author: AiyexAyen
Description:
[size=3][b]Kingdom Hearts Shirts[/b] is a collection for the Fashion Sense framework. It includes 29 character cosplay shirts and 13 additional merch-like shirts based on KH themes and icons.[/size]


[size=4][u][b]Notes

[/b][/u][/size][list]
[*]All shirts are available immediately with the Fashion Sense hand mirror sold at Pierre's (see the required [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ mod for more details).
[*]There are no pants or other accessories at this time, but the shirts pair well with the in-game dyeable pants and skirts, available [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Tailoring#Pants]via tailoring[/url]﻿ in the vanilla game or by using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ mod.
[*]Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15431]SH's Gloves and Sleeves Pack[/url]﻿﻿﻿ for colourable long sleeves/short sleeves and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16195]Hoods and Hoodies[/url]﻿ for Organization XIII robe hoods. There are currently no plans to add any custom sleeves or hoods into the Kingdom Hearts Shirts mod itself.
[*]Additionally, check out my mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21335]Kingdom Hearts Hairstyles[/url]﻿ that go with the shirts for the full cosplay experience.
[/list]
[size=4][u][b]How To Use:[/b][/u][/size]

1. Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ is installed and updated to the latest version.
2. Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] is installed and updated to the latest version.
3. Download the Kingdom Hearts Shirts .zip file.
4. Unzip and add folder to your Mods folder.
5. Run the game and find the shirts listed in the Fashion Sense hand mirror.

Downloads.Description: Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6. Requires Fashion Sense.
